parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no participating member records (members: []), no shared field count, no Jaccard similarity score, and no differing-slot data — all structural evidence fields are null. Without any grounded field-list overlap, type signatures, or context flags to cite, there is no evidence base from which to derive a defensible refactor action. The cluster_id references MetadataLabel in MetadataItem.swift and LinkButtonLabel in LinkButtonLabel.swift, but the subset-pairs signal cannot be evaluated without the actual member payloads.
